name: Aaron Parton
headline: Analyst turned founder. I build AI automations, websites and ad systems that bring small businesses leads.
about: In May 2026 I left Alcoa to go full time on Mycelium AI. Before that I spent three years in analytics and procurement at Alcoa and AFGRI Equipment, building the Power BI dashboards and reports teams ran their decisions on. Now I build lead pipelines, websites, paid ads and AI agents for Australian businesses, from Pilbara contractors to a Perth speech pathology practice, and I open-source a lot of what I build.

experience.summary: Perth agency building websites, lead pipelines, paid ads and AI automations for Australian businesses.
highlights: Worked with 25+ businesses across trades, construction, agriculture, transport and allied health.
Grundy Drilling: 234 leads from $1,037 of Meta ads, $4.43 a lead.
Every lead pipeline texts the client and me the second an enquiry lands, and logs it to their CRM.
Automated Jaylon Industries' monthly Grain Storage Review: one write-up goes to Mailchimp, WordPress, LinkedIn and Facebook.

experience.summary: Worked right across Alcoa's procurement teams: goods and services, supply chain and operations at Wagerup Refinery, and sustaining capital projects.
highlights: Built Alcoa Procurement's first Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) dashboard in Power BI, joining data from five source systems.
Built an automated civils overcharge report that checks supplier invoices against contract rates. It found six-figure overcharges and stops them recurring.
Built a Contracts Clarity dashboard that uses AI text extraction to surface key commercial terms, so buyers stop making costly mistakes.
Delivered Power BI reports (DAX, Power Query, governed data models) behind high-value tenders, sourcing decisions and supplier performance reviews.
Supported sustaining capital projects with procurement planning, supplier engagement and package tracking, working with buyers and project engineers.

experience.role: Business Intelligence Analyst, then Inventory Controller
experience.summary: Started as a graduate BI analyst running monthly analytics, then moved into inventory control.
highlights: Delivered monthly financial and operational analytics to support management decisions.
Cleaned, validated and transformed ERP data to make reporting accurate.
Produced sales and inventory reports that improved stock visibility and planning.
Worked with vendors, suppliers and logistics providers to resolve data and supply problems.

faq.q: What do you build for clients?
faq.a: Websites, lead-generation systems and AI automations for small businesses, mostly trades and service businesses around Australia.

Because you can't outwork a digital asset. At Alcoa I sold my time, and time doesn't scale. Code and content do: an automation runs while I sleep and a video keeps finding people for years. Leaving a good job looked backwards to most people, which is exactly why I did it. I'd rather work hard now on things that compound than stay comfortable on things that don't.

faq.q: How do I work with you?
faq.a: Email me at aaron@myceliumai.com.au and tell me what's eating your time. I'll come back with what I'd automate first.
